payload.title: Ship an app-route helper kit (CORS, JSON I/O, :param router, bearer→session auth)
payload.description:
Frick hands appRoutes a raw (req,res) with no framework context, so every app rewrites the same glue. Reference impl: ~/dev/aquariusyacht/apps/backend/src/runtime/http.ts — setCors, handlePreflight, sendJson, readJsonBody, a :param matchPath matcher, and authenticate (bearer token → store.sessions.readActive → principal). All of it is generic except the one app-specific line that maps userId→role; keep that pluggable (callback or leave role resolution to the app). Ship as a small re-exported helper module from @fricken/server. Low-risk, universally useful — start here.

See also the route assembly pattern in apps/backend/src/runtime/routes.ts (createCommandRoutes + late bindStore).
